pay_detail: Paid Work Experiences: Youth Job Center covers all costs, including salary. The pay rate is not stated on the pages read. Coaching and training are free.
name: Youth Job Center: coaching and Paid Work Experiences
org: Youth Job Center (Evanston, Englewood and Pilsen)
city: Evanston, IL (also Englewood and Pilsen in Chicago)
what_you_do: Get free job coaching, workforce readiness training and job placement. A Paid Work Experience is a 10 week job that is part work and part structured learning, with a chance to be hired for good.
who_can_apply: Young people ages 14 to 25 in the greater Chicagoland area. Services are free.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Sign up any time using the interest form.
how_to_apply: Fill out the interest form on the sign-up page. Current clients can talk to their career coach about a Paid Work Experience. Phone (847) 864-5627, 1114 Church Street, Evanston.
notes: A Chicago-area nonprofit that has worked with young people for over 40 years. Text YJCNEWS to (224) 253-6233 for updates. Ask the staff about work permits if you are under 16. In Illinois, workers under 16 need a work permit (employment certificate) before they start. This comes from the Evanston Township High School work permit page.
